review.note: Reviewed fresh PyPI/npm candidates for all direct build, runtime, optional/development and Node dependencies, including versions outside declared upper bounds. All public third-party candidate versions are unchanged from the committed Core 0.40.0 audit; the identical-version upstream reviews carry forward. Installed direct third-party versions match every latest candidate, and the recorded bounds still admit those versions and Python 3.14. Core 0.41.0 intentionally changes epoch-3 schema 7 to schema 8 and adds durable initial-scan collection checkpoints, normalized staging ownership, sealed-source restart recovery and bounded SQL work/diagnostics. The exact schema-7 offline upgrade preserves published catalog, source, artifact descriptors and partial staging children on SQLite and MariaDB; schema-6 databases first require the prior Core 0.40.0 upgrade-audit-schema tool. One-time conversion is separate from runtime admission, which has no previous-schema fallback. Manual fault/deep/MariaDB results and the exact-tree release gate remain separate evidence. Built candidate wheels h2hdb-0.41.0 and h2hdb_ingest-0.27.0 were explicitly installed together, offline from the existing registry cache, into a newly created independent CPython 3.14.1 virtual environment; uv pip check passed for all 14 runtime packages. Isolated-mode imports resolved only to that environment, direct_url metadata records local wheel files without editable flags, and every installed package file was byte-compared with its wheel (95 Core files and 47 Ingest files). Pillow 12.3.0 and libvips 8.18.6 loaded successfully. This verifies frozen dependency and wheel metadata; implementation work continued after candidate wheel creation, so these candidate hashes do not attest the final runtime tree. The exact-tree gate and final distribution build separately validate the released implementation.
